Cost: 250eb (Expensive) for 1
Stack: 1

Only detonates when it hits Cover. Against a single layer of Thin Cover it drills through and explodes on the far side for 6d6 in a 6x6m/yds (3x3 square) area spreading out from the impact, like a shotgun shell. Thick Cover is treated as Thin Cover of the same material (e.g., 25 HP thick concrete becomes 10 HP thin concrete), and only the Cover takes damage; none carries past it. Can't be combined with the Homing or Sticky Adapter Kits.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
